projects.name: Amazon (AWS) expanded PPA
projects.quote: Under the expanded PPA, at the full contract quantity, Talen expects to provide AWS with up to 1,920 MWs of “front-of-the-meter” power through 2042, with options to further extend its duration.

projects.name: Freedom and Guernsey acquisition
projects.quote: The net acquisition price is $3.5 billion after adjusting for estimated tax benefits, or approximately $3.8 billion gross.
